First, I need to identify which rider had the most points from the 1999 Dutch TT race. The table lists points for each finishing position from 1st to 15th, with positions 16th and beyond not receiving points (indicated by empty cells in the Points column).  

Looking at the Points column:  
- Loris Capirossi (Pos 1) has 25 points.  
- Valentino Rossi (Pos 2) has 20 points.  
- Jeremy McWilliams (Pos 3) has 16 points.  
- Others have fewer points as position decreases.  

No other rider has more than 25 points, so Loris Capirossi has the highest points.  

Final Answer: Loris Capirossi
